correctness.rationale: PASS: The bracket is det(x,y,z)e1. Preservation yields exactly Pe1=det(P)e1, equivalent to upper-left λ≠0 and lower-right SL2. In char≠2 a nonscalar involution has complementary 1+2 eigenspaces, every such eigenspace is a ternary-abelian subalgebra. For any endomorphism, the Nijenhuis defect vanishes by the source symbolic multilinear expansion; the inspected independent sympy checker substitutes a fully arbitrary nine-entry operator, not one normal form. The characteristic line D=Ke1 has exactly three invariant incidences and group shears/SL2 act transitively on each, as seen by bases modulo D. Each line in F_q^3 has q² plane complements; counting whether D is the line, lies in the plane, or neither yields q²,q²(q+1),q²(q²−1) per eigenspace signature and total formula. Inspected exact F3 F5 orbit enumeration algorithm and normal forms; no characteristic-2 inference.
